name: Lyra Starborn
title: Astral Mage
greeting: The stars have been restless since the Fracture...
Every great adventurer starts somewhere. Yours starts here.

name: Garrick Ironhand
title: Blacksmith & Refiner
greeting: Steel doesn't lie. Neither do I.
Need something sharper? You've come to the right anvil.

name: Seraphine Vale
title: Adventurer's Guild Master
greeting: Welcome to the Adventurer's Guild of Willowbrook.
Novices who reach Job Level 10 may take a Job Trial here.

name: Marla
title: Innkeeper
greeting: Rest your feet, dear. The Sleeping Willow always has a bed.

name: Pip Tumbleweed
title: Tool Merchant
greeting: Potions! Wings! Everything a hero needs, at prices a hero can afford!

name: Bram
title: Storage Keeper
greeting: Your belongings are safe with me. Small fee, big peace of mind.

name: Old Man Theo
title: Village Elder
greeting: In my day, the stars stayed in the sky where they belonged.

name: Guard Rowan
title: Village Guard
greeting: East gate leads to Sunny Meadow. Watch for slimes. And wasps. Mostly wasps.

name: Farmer Hollis
title: Meadow Farmer
greeting: Those rabbits are eating my carrots again!

name: Ranger Elwin
title: Forest Warden
greeting: Quiet... the forest is listening.
Goblins have grown bold since the Thornking claimed the clearing.

title: Courier Guild Service

name: Pet Keeper Lumi
title: Pet Keeper
greeting: Tame a monster with its lure: weaken it first, the lower its HP the better your chance. Feed your pet when it is hungry — never when it is full — and it will grow Loyal.

name: Courier Fiona
title: Courier Guild Service
greeting: The Courier Guild connects every town in Veyloria. Where to?

name: Astrologer Nim
title: Reader of the Rune Constellation
greeting: From Base Level 30 the stars answer you: one rune point every two levels. Spend them in the Rune window (N). For 10,000 Luma I can clear the sky and give the points back.

name: Stablemaster Rook
title: War-drake Stable
greeting: Knights ride war-drakes: faster, and they carry 1,000 more weight, but you swing slower until you train Drake Riding.

name: Sir Caldus
title: Dragoon Captain
greeting: Knights who ride war-drakes and break lines with the spear. Come back as a Knight of Job Level 40 and I will promote you.

name: Dame Ysolde
title: Templar Commander
greeting: Shield-bearing knights sworn to the dawn; holy strikes and unbreakable defence. Come back as a Knight of Job Level 40 and I will promote you.

name: Old Brannoc
title: Beastmaster Elder
greeting: Rangers who hunt with traps and a trained falcon. Come back as a Ranger of Job Level 40 and I will promote you.

name: Lysander
title: Master of Songs
greeting: Travelling musicians whose songs strengthen and whose arrows sing. Come back as a Ranger of Job Level 40 and I will promote you.

name: Archmagus Theron
title: Sorcerer Council
greeting: Mages who master storms, quakes and walls of ice. Come back as a Mage of Job Level 40 and I will promote you.

name: Scholar Imre
title: Sage Academy Dean
greeting: Scholars of every element who endow weapons and hit with the book. Come back as a Mage of Job Level 40 and I will promote you.

name: Bishop Aurenne
title: Bishop of the Dawn
greeting: High clerics: great heals, blessings and holy judgement. Come back as a Cleric of Job Level 40 and I will promote you.

name: Master Kaito
title: Ascetic of the Peak
greeting: Clerics who left the chapel for the mountain, fighting with fists and spirit. Come back as a Cleric of Job Level 40 and I will promote you.

name: The Veiled One
title: Shadowblade Guild
greeting: Rogues who kill from the shadows with katars and poison. Come back as a Rogue of Job Level 40 and I will promote you.

name: Jax Silverhand
title: Outlaw Boss
greeting: Rogues who rob, strip and outsmart, with blade or bow. Come back as a Rogue of Job Level 40 and I will promote you.

name: Forge-master Brenna
title: Artisan Guild
greeting: Merchants turned smiths: they forge better and fight with heavy weapons. Come back as a Merchant of Job Level 40 and I will promote you.

name: Professor Quill
title: Alchemy Guild
greeting: Merchants of the laboratory: acid, fire flasks and an artificial life-form. Come back as a Merchant of Job Level 40 and I will promote you.

name: Oracle Seraphel
title: Oracle of Rebirth
greeting: At Base Level 99 and Job Level 50 a second job may be reborn: you start again as a High Novice with 100 stat points, and your body grows stronger (+25% HP and MP).
Reborn ones return to me to take their High job, and later the transcendent job of the path they walked before.

name: Master Corvin
title: Job Master
greeting: I can change your class here: first job at Job Level 10, second job at Job Level 40, rebirth at Base 99 / Job 50, then the High and transcendent jobs.

name: Arena Master Kord
title: Proving Grounds & Castle Veyl
greeting: The Proving Grounds and Castle Veyl are for online play: other players can fight you there. Castle Veyl opens for the guild war every evening, 20:00–21:00 server time.

name: Warden Isolde
title: Keeper of the Endless Spire
greeting: A hundred floors, each sealed until every monster on it is defeated. Monsters grow stronger every floor and an elite guards every tenth. Rewards at floors 25, 50 and 75, and at the top. 3 hours; once per day.

name: Brother Halvard
title: Keeper of the Sealed Crypt
greeting: Four sealed rooms of restless dead and a Revenant guardian at the bottom. 20 minutes; once per hour.

name: Trader Moss
title: Market Trader
greeting: I buy anything — at today's price. Prices change every hour with supply and rarity; check the graph before you sell.

name: Market Hall Clerk
title: Market Hall
greeting: The Market Hall lists goods from other adventurers. Only real players buy here, so price your goods well.
